fusions.name: Raid the Larder
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles onto the target and tear into it for 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Broach the Cask
fusions.desc: Sprays a cask through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Splice the Mainbrace
fusions.desc: You regain 10 health, and every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Rations by the League
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
